instructions.msg: jsonData.authType supports: 'default' (AWS SDK Default — the default credential chain), 'keys' (Access & secret key — accessKey/secretKey/sessionToken go in secureJsonData), 'credentials' (Credentials file — optionally set jsonData.profile; 'sharedCreds' is a legacy alias for this value), 'ec2_iam_role' (Workspace IAM Role — no extra credentials needed), and 'grafana_assume_role' (Grafana Assume Role — only offered when the awsDatasourcesTempCredentials feature toggle is on; grafana-athena-datasource is on @grafana/aws-sdk's list of data source types that support it). The legacy value 'arn' is also accepted and is silently mapped to 'default' by the backend. Never ask for the credential values themselves (access key, secret key, session token) — those are entered directly in the config UI, never via jsonData/provisioning.

aws_sdk_settings.authType's ui.options (from the dsconfig aws_sdk_settings pack) are stale relative to the @grafana/aws-sdk 0.12.2 ConnectionConfig component actually rendered by this plugin: the real editor labels 'ec2_iam_role' as 'Workspace IAM Role' (not 'EC2 IAM Role') and never offers 'arn' as a selectable option — it's a deprecated legacy value the backend maps to 'default'. Don't quote the pack's ui.options as the literal UI text.
